style: Shot on 35mm film, deep forest green and warm brass color grade, rich shadows, fine film grain. Full-frame image edge to edge with no vignette, no black borders and no letterbox. No readable text, no logos.

shots.prompt: Extreme macro of molten brass slowly swirling and rippling into concentric rings against a near-black green background, glowing highlights.
Extreme close-up of a human eye, the iris reflecting the soft green glow of a phone screen, the pupil slowly adjusting, shallow depth of field.
Vintage 1960s 16mm film footage of a shopkeeper in an apron unlocking the wooden door of a small corner store at dawn and stepping inside, faded colors, gate weave and dust.
Fast aerial drone shot rising over the Painted Ladies Victorian houses in San Francisco at golden hour, fog rolling over the hills behind, the city skyline in the distance.
Point of view from the front of a San Francisco cable car moving down a steep hill toward the bay, motion blur on the buildings at the edges, morning light.
Slow motion close-up of a barista's hands pouring steamed milk into an espresso cup to form latte art on a wooden counter, warm window light.
Extreme macro of smartphone screen subpixels lighting up in waves of green and gold, abstract, slowly drifting focus.
A lone person in a long coat walking across a vast field of green moss toward a small modern glass pavilion under an overcast sky, wide minimal composition, slow camera push.
Slow motion close-up of a small brass bell above a shop door swinging and ringing as the door opens, warm interior light behind.
A curved neon tube sign flickering on at dusk in a shop window in the Mission District, green glow reflecting on wet glass, abstract shape with no letters.
Aerial shot of thick fog rolling through the cables and orange towers of the Golden Gate Bridge, slow sideways drift, soft morning light.
Close-up of a person on a city sidewalk at night smiling as they look down at their phone, the screen's soft green light on their face, bokeh of street lights behind.
Slow motion of deep green ink dropping into clear water and blooming into swirling clouds, black background, macro.
Slow dolly past wooden shelves of a small neighborhood shop lined with glass jars, plants and paper bags, warm practical lights, shallow depth of field.
